instruction: I need to configure Thunderbird with my Office 365 account (admin@business.com) for sending emails only, using the Microsoft SMTP relay. Don't set up the receiving part.

metadata.explanation: Task variation for Office 365 SMTP configuration. Verifies basic SMTP settings (server hostname, port, username, and email) are configured correctly for send-only operation. Also verifies that no incoming mail server (IMAP/POP3) is configured, ensuring send-only setup. While OAuth2 authentication cannot be fully validated, the basic SMTP configuration elements are verifiable through Thunderbird's prefs.js file.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses check_thunderbird_prefs to verify SMTP configuration in Thunderbird's prefs.js file

Complete coverage: All instruction requirements are verified - SMTP server (smtp.office365.com), port (587), username (admin@business.com), email identity (admin@business.com), and send-only configuration (no imap/pop3 incoming servers)
Correct metric parameter handling: check_thunderbird_prefs receives rules dict directly as 'rule' parameter and correctly accesses rule.get('expect') and rule.get('unexpect')
Expected values are semantically correct for Office 365 SMTP relay configuration
Proper postconfig: Closes Thunderbird and waits before reading prefs.js to ensure configuration is persisted
Logic flow is sound: VM file getter extracts prefs.js → check_thunderbird_prefs parses preferences → verifies expected SMTP settings exist and unexpected incoming server settings do not exist

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_thunderbird_prefs first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
